title: Abijah's War with Jeroboam

questions.question: Who began to reign over Judah in the eighteenth year of Jeroboam?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 13:1 (ESV): "In the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam, Abijah began to reign over Judah."

questions.question: How many chosen men of war did Abijah have?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 13:3 (ESV): "Abijah went out to battle... with 400,000 chosen men of war."

questions.question: How many chosen men did Jeroboam draw up against him?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 13:3 (ESV): "...Jeroboam drew up his line of battle... with 800,000 chosen mighty warriors."

questions.question: What did Abijah claim about the kingdom of the LORD?
options: It is in the hand of the sons of David
questions.correctAnswer: It is in the hand of the sons of David
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 13:8 (ESV): "And now you think to withstand the kingdom of the LORD in the hand of the sons of David..."

questions.question: Who did Abijah say was with Judah at their head?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 13:12 (ESV): "Behold, God is with us at our head..."

questions.question: What covenant did God make with David regarding the kingdom?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 13:5 (ESV): "...the LORD God of Israel gave the kingship over Israel forever to David and his sons by a covenant of salt."

questions.question: What did Jeroboam make himself?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 13:8 (ESV): "...and you have with you the golden calves that Jeroboam made you for gods."

questions.question: What tactic did Jeroboam use in the battle?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 13:13 (ESV): "Jeroboam sent an ambush around to come on them from behind..."

questions.question: What happened when the men of Judah shouted?
options: God defeated Jeroboam and all Israel
questions.correctAnswer: God defeated Jeroboam and all Israel
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 13:15 (ESV): "...God defeated Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah."

questions.question: How many men of Israel fell slain?
Why did the people of Judah prevail?
options: Because they relied on the LORD, the God of their fathers
questions.correctAnswer: Because they relied on the LORD, the God of their fathers
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 13:18 (ESV): "...The people of Judah prevailed, because they relied on the LORD, the God of their fathers."

questions.question: Which cities did Abijah take from Jeroboam?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 13:19 (ESV): "And Abijah pursued Jeroboam and took cities from him, Bethel... Jeshanah... and Ephron..."

questions.question: What happened to Jeroboam eventually?
options: The LORD struck him and he died
questions.correctAnswer: The LORD struck him and he died
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 13:20 (ESV): "...The LORD struck him, and he died."

questions.question: How many wives and children did Abijah have?
options: Fourteen wives, twenty-two sons, and sixteen daughters
questions.correctAnswer: Fourteen wives, twenty-two sons, and sixteen daughters
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 13:21 (ESV): "But Abijah grew mighty. And he took fourteen wives and had twenty-two sons and sixteen daughters."

questions.question: Where did Abijah stand to speak to Jeroboam?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 13:4 (ESV): "Then Abijah stood up on Mount Zemaraim..."

key_verse_text: Behold, God is with us at our head, and his priests with their battle trumpets to sound the call to battle against you. O sons of Israel, do not fight against the LORD, the God of your fathers, for you cannot succeed.
